%I;dAL;o(%7Kh5=Sf/#D.text:
"Scroll X & Y" hold the horizontal and vertical distance that a level is current scrolled
                  to right now.  It is a global variable (all sprites can see it).

"Next Scr X & Y" hold the location the level will be scrolled to when it is next re-drawn (Having a current and next scroll x & y allows us to position our sprites to be drawn lined up with the level where it will be next, but check for collisions with where it is now).

"Player X & Y" hold the position of the player
"Speed X & Y" hold the players momentum (speed)
"Can Jump?" must be greater than 0 for the player to be able to jump.
